notes: Two taḥwil branches under مسدد. The names after the last ح (ابن عجلان, عمرو بن شعيب, أبيه, جده) are written once and belong to both branches, so they are the shared tail.
«قال عن سفيان» and «وقال في حديث يحيى» are wording variants and are left out. The bare «أبيه» and «جده» are relation links.
